# Session 4 — Practical: Statistical inference — hypotheses and tests

Use the dataset for your specialisation that you worked with in practicals 2 and 3. In this session, you will carry out **inferential analyses (statistical tests)** to examine a variable's distribution and compare group means.

You may submit this assignment individually or in pairs. We strongly encourage you to work together to discuss your choices and learn from mistakes.

This practical has six parts. Some code is already provided in executable cells. The plotting code to copy from the course is identified by its **block number and title**. Copy each block into your working environment, keep its title comment, and adapt it. Run the cells in order to avoid accidentally overwriting variables with inappropriate values.

## Getting started

Save this file in a new working folder containing the `data` folder from practical 2. Rename it `Session4_EN_SURNAME_Firstname`, keeping its file extension. If you are working in a pair, include both names.

The [five CSV files](https://flo-unige.github.io/analyse-donnees-statistiques/donnees/index-en.html) are the same as in the previous session. Each file contains data for 195 countries in 2021 or 2022, with one row per country.

| Dataset | File in `data/` |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| Ecological and social transition | `transition_ecologique_sociale_2021.csv` |
| Energy | `energie_2021.csv` |
| Climate impact | `impact_climatique_2021.csv` |
| Water | `eau_2022.csv` |
| Biodiversity | `biodiversite_2022.csv` |

Double-click the `.Rmd` file you created to open RStudio in the correct working folder. Alternatively, start RStudio, open the document, then choose **Session > Set Working Directory > To Source File Location** to work in the practical's folder. Run code chunks using the green triangles and write your answers in the spaces provided outside the code.
